parameters.name: NodeConfig
parameters.description: The advanced configuration of the node. The value is in JSON string format.

parameters.name: NodeId
parameters.description: The node ID. You can call the [GetTaskInstanceRelation](~~424711~~) operation to obtain this parameter.

parameters.name: Tid
parameters.description: The tenant ID. You can call the [GetUserActiveTenant](~~198073~~) or [ListUserTenants](~~198074~~) operation to obtain this parameter.
